title: Delhi Police Head Constable AWO/TPO Result 2026 Out, Cut Off Marks, Merit List PDF Download Link
fullContentHtml:
SSC Delhi Police Head Constable AWO / TPO Result 2026 is out on 29th May for the posts of Assistant Wireless Operator (AWO) and Tele-Printer Operator (TPO) in Delhi Police. The written exam was conducted from 15 January 2026 to 22 January 2026. Many candidates appeared in the exam and those who passed will now go to the next stage, which includes PE&MT, Document Verification and Trade Test. Candidates can check their result and cut-off marks on the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.

Delhi Police Head Constable Result 2026 Out

The SSC has declared the Delhi Police Head Constable Result 2026 for Assistant Wireless Operator and Tele-Printer Operator on its official website. The result has been released category-wise for male, female, departmental and ex-servicemen candidates based on normalized scores obtained in the Computer Based Examination. Candidates who have secured marks equal to or above the prescribed cut-off marks have been shortlisted for the next stage of recruitment. SSC has also published detailed cut-off marks and the number of candidates shortlisted under each category along with the result PDF.

Delhi Police AWO TPO Result 2026 Download Link

Candidates can download the Delhi Police Head Constable AWO/TPO Result 2026 PDF from the official website of the Staff Selection Commission. The result PDF contains the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the PE&MT, DV and Trade Test rounds. SSC will soon upload the final answer keys and marks of both qualified and non-qualified candidates. Candidates can click on the direct link below to download the Delhi Police AWO TPO result 2026 PDF.

Delhi Police Head Constable AWO TPO Result 2026: Click Here to Download PDF

SSC Head Constable AWO/TPO Result 2026: Overview

The Delhi Police Head Constable AWO/TPO Result has been announced on 29th May 2026 for candidates who appeared in the written examination held in January 2026. Candidates shortlisted in the result will now appear for physical and document verification stages.

How to Download Delhi Police Head Constable Result 2026?

Candidates can download their TPO AWO Delhi Police result 2026 online from the SSC website, ssc.gov.in. Follow the steps mentioned below to get the result PDF. You can click on the link shared above to directly download the SSC Head Constable TWO APO Result 2026 PDF or get it from the website.

  1. Visit the official SSC website.
  2. Click on the “Results” section available on the homepage.
  3. Select the “Delhi Police” tab.
  4. Find and click on the “Head Constable AWO/TPO Result 2026” link.
  5. Download the result PDF file.
  6. Search your roll number using Ctrl + F.
  7. Save the PDF for future reference.

Details Mentioned in Delhi Police Head Constable AWO/TPO Result 2026

The AWO TPO Delhi Police result 2026 PDF released by SSC contains important details related to the shortlisted candidates and examination status. Candidates must carefully verify all details mentioned in the result.

  • Candidate’s Roll Number
  • Category of Candidate
  • Qualifying Status
  • Cut-off Marks
  • Examination Name
  • Post Name
  • Gender-wise Result Details
  • Instructions for Next Stage
  • Shortlisted Candidate Information

What Happens After AWO TPO Delhi Police Result 2026?

Candidates who passed the Delhi Police Head Constable AWO/TPO Exam 2026 will now go to the next stage of the selection process. First, they will have to appear for the Physical Endurance & Measurement Test (PE&MT). After that, there will be Document Verification and a Trade Test. Delhi Police will soon release the dates and admit cards on its official website. Candidates should keep all their important documents ready, like educational certificates, category certificates, NCC certificates and RRU Degree/Diploma documents if needed. SSC also said that bonus marks for NCC and RRU certificates will be added during the final result after checking the documents.

Delhi Police Head Constable AWO/TPO Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is the Delhi Police Head Constable AWO TPO Result 2026 released?

Yes, SSC has officially released the Delhi Police Head Constable AWO/TPO Result 2026 on 29th May in PDF format on its website, ssc.gov.in.

Q2. When was the Delhi Police Head Constable AWO TPO exam 2026?

The Computer Based Examination was held from 15 January to 22 January 2026.

Q3. What is the next stage after the written AWO Delhi police result?

Shortlisted candidates will appear for PE&MT, Document Verification and Trade Test.

Q4. Where can candidates check the SSC Head Constable TWO APO Result 2026?

Candidates can check the result on the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.

Q5. Will SSC release the final answer key and marks?

Yes, SSC will upload the final answer key and marks of qualified and non-qualified candidates in due course.
